name: zodiacally-ephemeris-benchmark
description: Reproducible comparison of Zodiacally Ephemeris with the Swiss Ephemeris (sweph) and NASA/JPL Horizons. Dev-only: sweph and the Swiss Ephemeris data files are installed here only and are never part of the zodiacally-ephemeris package.

scripts.all: node fetch-swiss-data.mjs && node speed.mjs && node agreement.mjs && node horizons.mjs && node summary.mjs
